layers.name: Task productivity
layers.detail: Average productivity gain for 5,179 customer-support agents given access to a generative-AI assistant; gains were much larger for novice and lower-skilled workers.
layers.source: NBER / Quarterly Journal of Economics study

layers.name: Enterprise monetization
layers.detail: Paid Microsoft 365 Copilot seats reported in FY2026 Q4, alongside rapid growth in large enterprise deployments.

layers.name: Broad realized ROI
layers.detail: There is still no broad, recurring primary dataset showing realized enterprise AI ROI across the economy. Case studies and vendor disclosures are useful but not a substitute.

reading: AI can create measurable value in specific workflows and is monetizing at scale, but broad realized enterprise ROI remains too unevenly measured to call the economic-value signal strong.
